sections.title: T1 , BPE with a byte budget (U01)

keyTerms.definition: 8 KB of firmware for the tokenizer.
Tokens per word; it drives latency.
The BPE table; too big for the budget.

recall.answer: The tokenizer must fit in 8 KB of firmware.

recall.question: What two things must the answer name?
recall.answer: Two mitigations that keep the model usable, and what fertility does to latency.

sections.title: T3 , MoE with one expert down (U03)

recall.question: What two things must the answer give?
recall.answer: Two serving-time mitigations and how load balancing affects the damage.
